Brawley (formerly, Braly) is a city in the Imperial Valley and within Imperial County, southern California, United States.
The population was 24,953 at the 2010 census, up from 22,052 in 2000. The town has a significant cattle and feed industry, and hosts the annual Cattle Call Rodeo.
